## One rule, four ideas

:::
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}

::: {.column width="25%"}
::: {.idea-card .fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}

<div class="big-label">Env per rule</div>
<div class="sub-label">conda · container</div>
:::
:::
:::
:::

```{.python style="margin-top: 1.4em;"}
rule align:
    input:  "fastq/{sample}.fq.gz"
    output: "bam/{sample}.bam"
    threads: 8
    resources: mem_mb=16_000, runtime=120
    conda:  "envs/bwa.yaml"
    shell:  "bwa mem -t {threads} ref {input} | samtools sort -o {output}"
```

## Wildcards → DAG → dry-run

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
You request **an output file**. Snakemake recurses back through rules until it hits files that already exist.

The DAG is built **statically** — every job is known up-front.

```bash
# show the full plan before running
snakemake bam/sample42.bam --dry-run

# emit Graphviz
snakemake --rulegraph | dot -Tpng > rules.png
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<div style="background: #e8f5f0; border-left: 4px solid #208F6E; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7em;">
<strong>Job stats</strong><br/>
<code>align&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</code> 96 jobs <br/>
<code>call_snvs&nbsp;&nbsp;</code> 96 jobs <br/>
<code>merge_vcfs&nbsp;&nbsp;</code> 1 job <br/>
<strong>total</strong> 193 jobs
</div>

<p style="margin-top: 1em; font-size: 0.85em;"><i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #208F6E;"></i>&nbsp; Same Snakefile, different `expand()` → 3 samples or 3000.</p>
:::
:::

## Reproducibility & provenance

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #208F6E;"><i class="mdi mdi-anvil"></i>&nbsp; Per-rule software</h4>

```python
rule call_snvs:
    container: "docker://broadinstitute/gatk:4.5"
    conda: "envs/gatk.yaml"
    shell: "gatk HaplotypeCaller ..."
```
Pinned envs solve once, cached forever (see HPC section).
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #208F6E;"><i class="mdi mdi-file-document"></i>&nbsp; Reports — auto since 9.1</h4>

```bash
snakemake --report report.html --report-after-run
```

<p style="font-size: 0.78em; margin-top: 0.4em;">`--report-after-run` (added v9.1.0, Mar 2025) triggers report generation **on successful completion** — no manual second run.</p>
:::
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 1em; padding: 0.8em 1em; background: #e8f5f0; border-left: 4px solid #208F6E; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85em;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-flask-outline" style="color: #208F6E;"></i>&nbsp; **Report plugins ecosystem** *(WIP — not yet on PyPI as of Q2 2026)*

- `snakemake-report-plugin-rocrate` → **Provenance Run Crate** *(Workflow-Run RO-Crate profile, Leo et al. PLOS ONE 2024)*
- `snakemake-report-plugin-nanopub` → machine-readable nanopublications
:::

## Monolith → plugin framework

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-package-variant-closed"></i>&nbsp; v7 (monolith)</h3>

All executors, all remote-storage backends, all software-deployment options shipped in **one package**.

```bash
snakemake --use-conda \
          --use-singularity \
          --cluster "sbatch ..."
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-puzzle"></i>&nbsp; v8 / v9 (plugins)</h3>

Engine + **5 plugin types**, each pip-installable:

- <i class="mdi mdi-server"></i>&nbsp; **Executor** — slurm, k8s, googlebatch …
- <i class="mdi mdi-database"></i>&nbsp; **Storage** — fs, s3, gcs, zenodo …
- <i class="mdi mdi-text-box"></i>&nbsp; **Logger** — snkmt …
- <i class="mdi mdi-file-document"></i>&nbsp; **Report** — rocrate, nanopub …
- <i class="mdi mdi-clock-fast"></i>&nbsp; **Scheduler** — greedy, ilp, milp
:::
:::

## Storage — in practice

<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-database"></i>&nbsp; The `storage` directive</h4>

```python
storage:
    provider="s3",
    max_requests_per_second=10

rule fetch:
    input:  storage("s3://bucket/in.txt")
    output: "local/in.txt"
```

::: {style="margin-top: 0.8em;"}
**Workflow-wide:**
:::

```bash
snakemake --default-storage-provider s3 \
          --default-storage-prefix s3://my-bucket/run42/
```

## Software deployment — one flag

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;">v7 — many flags</h4>
```bash
--use-conda
--use-singularity
--use-envmodules
--conda-frontend mamba
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;">v8 / v9 — one flag</h4>
```bash
--sdm conda
--sdm apptainer
--sdm conda apptainer
--sdm env-modules
```
:::
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 1.2em;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-information" style="color: #8E44AD;"></i>&nbsp; `--conda-frontend mamba` removed — `libmamba` is the default solver · Pixi backend on the roadmap.
:::

## CLI rename — what to change in your profile

::: {.cli-rename}

| v7 | v8 / v9 |
|----|---------|
| `--use-conda` | `--sdm conda` |
| `--use-singularity` | `--sdm apptainer` |
| `--use-envmodules` | `--sdm env-modules` |
| `--singularity-args` | `--apptainer-args` |
| `--cluster "sbatch ..."` | `--executor slurm` *(or `cluster-generic`)* |
| `--drmaa` · `--kubernetes` · `--google-lifesciences` | `--executor <name>` |
| `--conda-frontend mamba` | <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i> removed |
| `--restart-times N` | `--retries N` |

:::

::: {style="margin-top: 0.6em; font-size: 0.8em;"}
<i class="mdi mdi-camera" style="color: #8E44AD;"></i>&nbsp; Profile schema is versioned too: place a `config.v8+.yaml` next to the legacy `config.yaml`.
:::

## What actually matters in v9.x

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-star"></i>&nbsp; New capabilities</h4>

- **Pluggable metadata persistence** — `.snakemake/` to files *or* DB
- **Cross-workflow caching** with storage-plugin checksums
- **Named multi-output caching**
- **Logger plugins** — observability (snkmt SQLite/TUI)
- **Report plugins** — RO-Crate (FAIR) · Nanopub
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #8E44AD;"><i class="mdi mdi-tools"></i>&nbsp; Quality-of-life</h4>

- `profile.yaml` is the new default filename
- Pass a YAML file directly (not just a directory)
- `subpath(with_suffix=...)` helper
- Auto-detected network FS type
- Plugins with no settings auto-deploy

<p style="margin-top: 0.6em;"><i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; <strong>9.20 footgun:</strong> <code>runtime</code> values are now <strong>minutes</strong>, not seconds.</p>
:::
:::

## Migration footguns

::: {.incremental}
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `dynamic()` outputs → use **checkpoints**
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `version:` directive → use `conda:` / `container:`
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `subworkflow:` → `module:` + `use rule * from foo as foo_*`
- <i class="mdi mdi-close-circle" style="color: #C0392B;"></i>&nbsp; `from snakemake.remote.*` → `storage` directive
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; CI must `pip install snakemake-executor-plugin-slurm` explicitly
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; v9.20: audit `runtime:` values — seconds became minutes
- <i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; v7 profiles reference removed flags — silently broken on v8
:::

<h1 style="color: #fff; margin-top: 0.8em;">Snakemake vs Nextflow</h1>
<p style="color: #c5d4e3; font-size: 0.6em;">Strictly objective · pick on <em>fit</em>, not on taste</p>
:::

## The deepest difference — dataflow

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-arrow-left-bold-circle"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake — **pull**</h3>

Target-driven, Make-style.

> *"What file do I want?"*

- Request output → recurse back
- Static DAG, built up-front
- `--dry-run` shows the full plan
- Conditional flow via Python / checkpoints
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

<h3 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-arrow-right-bold-circle"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow — **push**</h3>

Channel-driven, Kahn / CSP-style.

> *"What stream into what process?"*

- Channels emit records
- Processes fire on input availability
- Dynamic DAG, materializes at runtime
- Branching native via operators
:::
:::

## Resume / cache — myth-buster

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-clock-outline"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake</h4>

File timestamps + tracked metadata in `.snakemake/`.

Triggers: `--rerun-triggers {mtime, params, input, software-env, code}`.

*Make pitfall:* touching an input invalidates downstream.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-hash"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow</h4>

Hash in `.nextflow/cache/` (LevelDB).

Hashes script + input *attributes* (path/size/**mtime**) by default — **not contents**.

`cache 'deep'` → true content hash · `cache 'lenient'` for shared FS.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
*"Nextflow -resume is content-hashed"* — **partially false**. Default = file attributes incl. mtime. Both tools are sensitive to FS metadata. Neither is magic.
:::

## Software & containers

| <i class="mdi mdi-format-list-checks" style="color: #1F3A5F;"></i>&nbsp; Capability | <i class="mdi mdi-snake" style="color: #208F6E;"></i> Snakemake | <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/6698688?s=24&v=4" style="height: 16px; vertical-align: middle; border-radius: 3px;"/>&nbsp; Nextflow / nf-core |
|---|---|---|
| <i class="mdi mdi-tag-multiple"></i>&nbsp; Per-rule env | `conda:` + `container:` | `conda` + `container` directive |
| <i class="mdi mdi-layers-triple"></i>&nbsp; Compose | `--sdm conda apptainer` | engine + conda |
| <i class="mdi mdi-warehouse"></i>&nbsp; Curated registry | snakemake-wrappers | BioContainers · mulled · **Seqera Containers** |
| <i class="mdi mdi-hammer-wrench"></i>&nbsp; Build on demand | — | **Wave** (Apache-2.0 OSS) |
| <i class="mdi mdi-folder-network"></i>&nbsp; POSIX over S3/GCS | — | **Fusion** (commercial) |

::: {.callout-warning}
**Wave is open-source.** Fusion is part of the commercial Seqera Platform.
:::

<code>group: · slurm-job-array</code>
:::
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.pillar-card}
<i class="mdi mdi-package-variant pillar-icon"></i>
<div class="pillar-label">EESSI / env-modules</div>

## 1 · Caching — workflow + containers

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22;"><i class="mdi mdi-cached"></i>&nbsp; Workflow output cache</h4>

```bash
export SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE=\
  /scratch_cached/<group>/snakemake_cache
```

Per rule:
```python
rule index_ref:
    output: "ref.fa.bwt"
    cache: True   # shared across users
```

Computed indexes (BWA, STAR, ref dicts) reused across users → minutes saved per run.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22;"><i class="mdi mdi-docker"></i>&nbsp; Container & conda cache</h4>

```yaml
# profile
conda-prefix:     /g/<group>/shared/conda
apptainer-prefix: /g/<group>/shared/apptainer
```

<i class="mdi mdi-folder-lock" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Group-writable, `chmod 2775` (setgid) → no per-user re-solves.

<i class="mdi mdi-rocket" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Pre-warm: `snakemake --conda-create-envs-only`
:::
:::

## 2 · Storage — staging via `fs` plugin

```{.yaml filename="profile/config.yaml" code-line-numbers="|2|3|4-7"}
executor: slurm
default-storage-provider: fs                       # auto-stage to scratch
local-storage-prefix: /scratch/$USER/snakemake/<wf>
shared-fs-usage:                                   # what stays on shared FS
  - persistence
  - software-deployment
  - sources                                        # NOT input-output!
```

| <i class="mdi mdi-file"></i> Data | <i class="mdi mdi-harddisk"></i> Tier | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Reference genomes · indexes | Cached parallel FS | Read 100× |
| BAM / CRAM intermediates | Parallel FS | Sequential writes |
| Conda · containers | Parallel FS (shared) | Multi-user reuse |
| Sorting · temp buffers | **Local scratch** | Ultra-fast, per-job |

## 3 · Job grouping + arrays

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```python
rule trim:
    input:  "fastq/{s}.fq.gz"
    output: "trim/{s}.fq.gz"
    group:  "preproc"   # ◀ same group

rule align:
    input:  "trim/{s}.fq.gz"
    output: "bam/{s}.bam"
    group:  "preproc"   # ◀ same SLURM job
```

```yaml
# profile — array submissions
executor: slurm
slurm-job-array: true
jobs: 500
max-jobs-per-second: 10
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; **Group:** one sbatch instead of two per sample · shared scratch.

<i class="mdi mdi-lightbulb-on" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; **Array:** batch homogeneous jobs into `sbatch --array=…` · single `squeue` entry.

<i class="mdi mdi-information" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Combine both → array of grouped jobs.

<i class="mdi mdi-alert" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Heterogeneous resources → keep arrays separate.
:::
:::

## 4 · EESSI — env-modules everywhere

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
**EESSI** = European Environment for Scientific Software Installations — a CernVM-FS stream of pre-built scientific software, mountable on any HPC.

```bash
source /cvmfs/software.eessi.io/versions/2023.06/init/bash
module load BWA SAMtools STAR
```

Per rule:
```python
rule align:
    envmodules: "BWA/0.7.17", "SAMtools/1.18"
    shell: "bwa mem ... | samtools sort ..."
```
Invoke with `--sdm env-modules`.
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
<i class="mdi mdi-rocket-launch" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; **No conda solve · no image pull**

<i class="mdi mdi-earth" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Identical tool versions across sites

<i class="mdi mdi-shield-check" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Reproducibility comparable to containers

[eessi.io](https://www.eessi.io)
:::
:::

## Bonus · dependency cooldowns

<h4><i class="mdi mdi-shield-lock" style="color: #E67E22;"></i>&nbsp; Why</h4>

Malicious PyPI / conda releases are usually yanked within hours to days. Tell your resolver to **ignore versions published in the last *N* days** → compromised releases disappear before your build ever sees them. Bonus: dampens surprise breakage.

::: {.columns style="margin-top: 0.8em;"}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.tip-card}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22; margin-top: 0;"><i class="mdi mdi-language-python"></i>&nbsp; pip 26.1 *(Apr 2026)*</h4>

```bash
pip install --uploaded-prior-to=P7D requests
```

- 26.0 → absolute date · 26.1 → relative duration
- Also in `pip.conf`
- Relies on PEP 700 upload time
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.tip-card}
<h4 style="color: #E67E22; margin-top: 0;"><i class="mdi mdi-package-variant"></i>&nbsp; Pixi · `exclude-newer`</h4>

```toml
[workspace]
exclude-newer = "14d"
channels = [
  "conda-forge",
  { channel = ".../internal",
    exclude-newer = "0d" }
]

[exclude-newer]
openssl = "0d"   # bypass for CVE
```
:::
:::
:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.7em; margin-top: 0.8em; color: #7f8c8d; text-align: center;"}
Same concept as uv/rattler · 7 days is the commonly cited default · [Richard Si's writeup](https://ichard26.github.io/blog/2026/04/whats-new-in-pip-26.1/)
:::

## A minimal end-to-end Snakefile

```{.python filename="Snakefile"}
configfile: "config/config.yaml"

SAMPLES = config["samples"]

rule all:
    input: expand("results/{sample}.vcf", sample=SAMPLES)

rule align:
    input:  "data/{sample}.fq.gz"
    output: "results/{sample}.bam"
    threads: 8
    resources: mem_mb=16_000, runtime=120     # ⚠ minutes since 9.20
    conda:   "envs/bwa.yaml"
    group:   "per_sample"
    shell:   "bwa mem -t {threads} ref {input} | samtools sort -o {output}"

rule call_snvs:
    input:  "results/{sample}.bam"
    output: "results/{sample}.vcf"
    container: "docker://broadinstitute/gatk:4.5"
    group:  "per_sample"
    shell:  "gatk HaplotypeCaller -I {input} -O {output}"
```

## A full EMBL HPC profile

```{.yaml filename="profile/config.yaml"}
executor: slurm
jobs: 500
max-jobs-per-second: 10
software-deployment-method: [conda, apptainer]

# software & cache
conda-prefix:     /g/<group>/shared/conda
apptainer-prefix: /g/<group>/shared/apptainer

# storage staging
default-storage-provider: fs
local-storage-prefix: /scratch/$USER/snakemake/<wf>
shared-fs-usage:
  - persistence
  - software-deployment
  - sources

# scheduler hygiene
slurm-job-array: true
slurm-efficiency-report: true
slurm-efficiency-threshold: 0.8
retries: 2
```

```bash
export SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE=/scratch_cached/<group>/snakemake_cache
snakemake --profile profile/ --jobs 500
```

## When does each fit? {visibility="uncounted"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-snake"></i>&nbsp; Snakemake fits when…</h4>

- Team is <i class="mdi mdi-language-python"></i> Python-native
- Pipeline is **file / target-driven**
- You want the **DAG up-front**
- Debugging needs interactive Python
- One Snakefile, readable end-to-end
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<h4 style="color: #1F3A5F;"><i class="mdi mdi-source-branch"></i>&nbsp; Nextflow fits when…</h4>

- Team has Groovy / JVM people
- Pipeline is **stream / event-driven**
- **AWS Batch** or **Fusion** matter
- You want **nf-core** off-the-shelf
- You want **Seqera Platform** observability
:::
:::
